package.name: 3D Avatar Maker: Clothes
package.description: 178 more pieces of clothing for 3D Avatar Maker's Clothes tab, from the MakeHuman community and free to share with credit to their makers (CC BY; a saved avatar carries the credits). Needs 3D Avatar Maker 0.1.03 or later. Install it beside 3D Avatar Maker, then open Home → 3D Avatar Maker → Clothes.
